subject: Annualized prepay: structured floor, billing acceleration & escalator request
messages:
From: Ellis Grant <ellis@healthlytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@healthlytics.com>, Healthlytics Finance <finance@healthlytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring a 3-year prepay with smoothing and billing acceleration

Ava,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the latency numbers you showed are promising for our production use. We're seriously considering a 2–3 year committed prepay to get the unit economics we need, but we have two requests from our CFO team:

- Can Redwood propose a structure that uses an annualized floor (so we guarantee a minimum $/month) while allowing us to accelerate billing in year 1 to align cash with our capital plans?
- We want an escalator tied to usage thresholds (small step-ups each year) rather than a hard cliff. We also need clarity on how unused prepay credits roll forward.

Attached is our internal 3-year forecast (usage_forecast_2027-2029.xlsx) to help you model the ramp. The key commercial ask from finance is ~20% effective discount in year 1 compared to list, smoothing into years 2–3. Can you sketch what that could look like and what approvals you'd need?

Best,
Ellis
VP of Product
Healthlytics

Attachments: usage_forecast_2027-2029.xlsx
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Grant <ellis@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@healthlytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring a 3-year prepay with smoothing and billing acceleration

Ellis — great context, thanks for sending the forecast. I ran the numbers with our sizing team and put together a starter term sheet for a 3-year commitment with the options you mentioned. High level: 

- Year 1: accelerated billing (100% of year 1 committed dollars billed upfront) in exchange for a 18% effective discount off list for year 1 unit rates;
- Years 2–3: annual prepay installments with a 10% discount off list, with a 3% escalator applied to annual committed volume if actual usage exceeds the forecasted tier by >20% (escrow-style recalibration at each anniversary);
- Unused credits: 12-month roll-forward window for credits, after which excess converts to a one-time usage credit at 50% of list to avoid indefinite carry;
- Clause: escape hatch for regulation changes and reasonable SLA breach (standard).

This gives you cash upfront for year 1 while smoothing effective unit economics over the term. That 18% is outside standard playbook and will require a finance/leadership exception — I'll loop in Marissa and Kar thik for approvals. If you want, I can send a clean term sheet and run a modeled scenario with your forecasted numbers.

Sending the sketch and the draft term sheet (Healthlytics_MultiYear_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf).

—Ava
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Healthlytics_MultiYear_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fw: Healthlytics - request for 18% y1 discount and billing acceleration (need approval)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Ellis's ask. Quick summary: Healthlytics is ready to commit to a 3-year prepay; they want full year-1 billing upfront for cashflow and are asking for an 18% effective discount in y1, then 10% in y2–3 with a usage-based 3% escalator. They also want a 12-month roll-forward for unused credits.

Why it's strategic: Healthlytics is an early enterprise in healthcare analytics with a big POC converting now. They were quoted at list for hosted tiers previously; this prepay would lock ~$3.2M ARR profile (annualized) and give Redwood predictable capacity planning in our us-east pools.

Questions for you:
- Finance: is 18% upfront outside our allowed ACV discount band for an accelerated 1st-year bill? If so, do we have guardrails (gross margin floor) that would allow this after approval?
- Legal/commercial: any guardrails we must add for roll-forward/credit conversion?

I've attached the forecast and the draft term sheet. Happy to sync 15 min.

—Ava

Attachments: Healthlytics_MultiYear_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf, usage_forecast_2027-2029.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fw: Healthlytics - request for 18% y1 discount and billing acceleration (need approval)

Ava/Marissa — reviewed the numbers and the forecast. Short answer: 18% in year 1 billed upfront is beyond the standard delegated discount for AE sign-off. We can approve an exception under these conditions: 

1) The effective gross margin after committed consumption must not drop below 45% (model attached).
2) Unused credit conversion at year-end must be capped (the 50% conversion to list is acceptable, but add clear audit rights on consumption data).
3) Include a cap on total rolled forward credits to 25% of the annual committed amount to avoid indefinite dilution.
4) Escalator: convert the 3% step-up to a tiered 2% / 3% / 4% based on overage bands to keep predictability.

If these conditions are acceptable, finance will sign off and we can route to Marissa for final commercial approval. Please get Healthlytics to confirm they accept the capped roll-forward and the margin floor — we need redlines resolved before DocuSign.

I'll attach a short margin sensitivity model in the follow-up.

—Karthik
Director, Revenue Finance

Attachments: rf-margin-sensitivity-hlt.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Grant <ellis@healthlytics.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annualized prepay: structured floor, billing acceleration & escalator request — Approved with commercial guardrails

Ellis / Priya — thanks for the patience while we validated internally. Redwood approves the 3-year prepay with the following commercial guardrails (final language to be inserted into the term sheet):

- Year 1 billing accelerated (paid upfront); Year 1 effective discount: 18% off list; Years 2–3: 10% off list;
- Margin floor: effective gross margin after committed consumption >= 45%;
- Unused credits: 12-month roll-forward window; annual cap on rolled credits at 25% of that year's committed amount; excess beyond cap converts to one-time usage credit at 50% of list;
- Escalator: tiered overage bands with 2% / 3% / 4% step-ups based on >20% / >40% / >60% over forecasted tier at anniversary;
- Audit: Redwood retains the right to audit usage imports twice per year to validate overage calculations;
- Standard SLA and regulatory escape clauses apply.

Next steps: Ava will incorporate these guardrails into the term sheet and send a final DocuSign link this week. Karthik/Finance have prepared the margin model for your review. If you confirm the roll-forward cap and escalator structure, we'll prepare the final agreement.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Strategic Accounts (Approvals)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Healthlytics_MultiYear_Term_Sheet_v3_FINAL.pdf (to follow), rf-margin-sensitivity-hlt.xlsx
